name: link-existence-v1
task: Does a repository-local CommonMark link destination exist relative to its instruction document in the pinned, unbuilt tracked Git snapshot? Missing means absent in this snapshot, not an upstream bug or unsafe instruction.
selection: Fixed eight-repository convenience registry before downloading these instruction contents or running ACS on them. None is in the existing registered evaluation registries. Prior general familiarity and model-training exposure are unknown. No replacements, balancing, or rule changes after acquisition.
documents: Select at most five regular tracked instruction files per repository: root AGENTS.md, root CLAUDE.md, .github/copilot-instructions.md, then remaining files named AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md in Unicode lexical path order. A selected file excluded for size, privacy, or UTF-8 does not get a replacement.
cases: Parse complete documents with the independent CommonMark parser. Visit link_open tokens in inline blocks spanning exactly one physical source line, including reference uses resolved by the full parser. Exclude external/anchor-only/absolute links, nonportable paths, out-of-root traversal and any document-relative or ACS-root-fallback candidate affected by a symlink/gitlink ancestor. Keep first occurrence of each decoded destination per document. Select first 40 eligible cases per repository and first 120 overall in registry/document/source order. Retain every exclusion and limit decision. Images, HTML links and multiline inline blocks are outside this task.
oracle: Strip URL query/fragment, URL-decode the destination; accept ASCII letters, digits, underscore, dot, slash, plus, at, hyphen and space only. Resolve lexically against the document parent. The root and Git tree entries with type tree or regular blob modes 100644/100755 exist. Symlink/gitlink-dependent cases are unresolved and excluded. Verify every retained tree by reconstructing its canonical Git object identities and every retained source against its Git blob.
prediction: Offline Linux names-only projection of the complete verified tree, exact selected document bytes, empty other regular files, no symlink/gitlink materialization. Research-scoped discovery selects one instruction file; ACS rules are unchanged. A case is flagged if a dead-path finding anywhere in that document has exactly its decoded destination. Record original source block and finding lines, but do not claim line-localization accuracy. Root-fallback behavior may disagree with strict document-relative Markdown semantics.
controls: Separately remove the existing regular-file target of the first six distinct eligible selected cases in registry order. Never remove the instruction file itself. Scan each removal independently; report separately from natural cases, with no substitution based on detection. No controls if insufficient eligible targets; report the shortfall.
reporting: This is a maintainer-run objective component check with an independent parser, not independent human review, general safety accuracy, random sampling, AI comparison or evidence of external adoption. Report TP/FP/TN/FN for snapshot target existence only, missing-target recall unavailable when no natural missing targets exist. Preserve misses and mismatches. Later fixes turn this corpus into development data and require a separate new study for validation.
